description: Submit an application to the 20-person spatial-computing beta. WRITES a real application under a real person's name and commits them to a 5-week in-person NDA-bound program, so CONFIRM EVERY ANSWER WITH YOUR HUMAN FIRST and never invent one on their behalf - particularly the NDA, commitment and in-person answers, which are promises they have to keep. Call ic_spatial_beta_program first for the catalog and the exact allowed values. One application per email address; a second is refused rather than silently merged. The response carries a `claim_token` shown EXACTLY ONCE: surface it to your human verbatim, because without it an applicant with no IC account can never read their own status again. No auth required; a token only attributes the application. Returns: { ok, application_id, claim_token, status, failed_gates, cohort, message }.

accessibility.description: Access needs or anything affecting headset use. Optional, accommodated, never used to screen anyone out.

availability.description: Exactly one of: Weekday daytime | Weekday evenings | Weekends | Flexible / most times. Required.

building_now.description: What they are building right now, in their own words. Required.

commit_5_weeks.description: Can they commit to the full 5 weeks? Required.

heard_via.description: How they heard about it. Optional.

in_person_sf.description: Can they get to Frontier Tower, San Francisco in person regularly? Required. The hardware never leaves the building.

nda_ack.description: Will they sign the strict NDA before their first session? Required. A false is honest and is recorded as a failed gate rather than blocked.

profile.description: Exactly one of: AI founder | Prompt engineer | Computational designer | Vibe coder | Spatial UI/UX tinkerer | XR developer | Researcher | Other. Required.

project_link.description: https URL to a project, GitHub or portfolio. Optional.

xr_experience.description: Exactly one of: None - total newcomer | Tried a few times | Regular user | I build for headsets. Required. Newcomers are WANTED - do not inflate this to make an application look stronger.

name: ic_spatial_beta_apply
title: Apply to the spatial-computing beta cohort (public)
